purpose: Determine the object's dimensional envelope by identifying its collection membership, coherence clusters, related objects, and regime profile.

target.description: The webpage or object being analyzed.

collection_id.description: The Internet Archive collection or sub-collection the object belongs to.

related_objects.description: Other IA objects structurally or contextually linked.

regime_profile.description: Combined regime identity across lineage and collection context.

procedure: Retrieve IA collection metadata for target.
Analyze structural similarity across related objects to form coherence_clusters.
Identify related objects using lineage identifiers, collection metadata, and structural similarity.
Combine collection regime and lineage regime to produce regime_profile.
Emit outputs for PRESERVATION_OPERATOR and DRIFTBOUND_RETRIEVAL_OPERATOR.
guarantees: Collection membership is structural, not semantic.
Related objects determined by structural similarity.
Regime profile is derived, not assumed.
Output deterministic given IA metadata and lineage.
